body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/35083

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1438

## Summary

- route text before the first opening reasoning marker to normal content
- preserve that leading text as reasoning when `force_reasoning` already opened the block
- hold back a trailing partial opening marker so streaming results no longer depend on chunk boundaries
- replace the pinned divergence test with invariance coverage and add newline, forced-reasoning, and incomplete-prefix boundaries

The prepared base still reproduced all four reported outputs. I also inspected the directly related open upstream candidate, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35085, before implementing and independently verifying the narrow correction here.

## Reproduction and validation

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c27c8b649c75/venv/bin/python reports/j-c27c8b649c75/reasoning_parser_regression.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c27c8b649c75/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/parser/test_reasoning_parser.py
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-c27c8b649c75/venv/bin/python -m compileall -q python/sglang/srt/parser/reasoning_parser.py test/registered/unit/parser/test_reasoning_parser.py reports/j-c27c8b649c75/reasoning_parser_regression.py
```

The standalone regression failed against base commit `358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365` and passes with this change. The parser test file passes 124 tests and 96 subtests.

## Limitations

This is a deterministic CPU-only parser defect. No GPU, model weights, serving process, semantic-accuracy test, or native rebuild was involved, and no claim is made about those paths. Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter; `git diff --check`, `compileall`, the standalone before/after regression, and the complete parser unit file were used instead. Full evidence and exact commands are retained under `reports/j-c27c8b649c75/`.
